declared_not_run.why_w12r_qualifier: w12r/MF16. `at K >= 36 composition collapses` is TRUE OF THE ONE CONFIGURATION AT K >= 36 WHOSE COMPOSITION WAS MEASURED, and must be stated that way. The same hub's 18:32Z `ward_balanced` sweep lists FIVE configurations that fit the 524,288 B pin at float64 - K=36 (span 144, 523,680 B, 0.999x), K=38 (span 266, 523,744 B, 0.999x), K=40 (span 360, 518,080 B, 0.988x), K=42 (span 504, 522,704 B, 0.997x), K=48 (span 864, 521,984 B, 0.996x) - and the composition of FOUR of them was never measured. The one that was measured is K=40 with A=7, span 280, 519,794 B = 0.991x (the 23:22Z entry), which sits BELOW the sweep's own K=40 row and below the composing object's realised span of 308: three of the five that fit the pin carry MORE deployed span than the object that composes at 0.8918. The threshold is also DTYPE-CONDITIONAL: the same hub's earlier sweep prints a float32 matched-bytes point at K=21, A=94, 517,952 B = 0.988x the pin, span 336, excluded by ARGUMENT (the peer's measured 1e-10..5e-10 downdate residuals are held not to survive float32) and NEVER MEASURED. The supported form is: NO OBJECT WITH A FLOAT64 SUFFICIENT STATISTIC composes and forgets inside 524,288 B, on the one such configuration measured.
